title: Apply for a commercial agent licence – individual/sole trader
summary: This page provides information and steps for individuals to apply for a commercial agent licence in NSW.
intro:
If you're a commercial agent who has face-to-face contact with customers (known as a field agent), you must hold a licence to collect debts, repossess goods and serve legal documents on behalf of a client.

Commercial agents who are not field agents do not need a licence.

Field agents who already hold a Commercial Agents and Private Inquiry Agents (CAPI) licence, will need a new commercial agent licence before the CAPI expiry date or 1 July 2023, whichever is sooner.

You can apply for a 1, 3 or 5-year licence.

Under the Automatic Mutual Recognition (AMR) scheme, holders of certain interstate licences can work automatically in NSW but must notify the licence regulator of their intention to work.
who_can_apply: Be a fit and proper person to hold a licence.
Not be an undischarged bankrupt or taking benefit of bankruptcy laws.
Not have an exclusion order that prohibits commercial agent activity.
Not have a NSW commercial agent licence that is currently cancelled, disqualified, or suspended.
Not be a controlled member of a declared organisation under the Crimes (Criminal Organisations Control) Act 2012.

Not have been convicted of a relevant offence (including violence, harassment, intimidation, weapons, drugs, and dishonesty) within the last 5 years that resulted in a prison sentence or a fine of $500 or more.
what_you_need: Your previous Commercial Agents & Private Inquiry Agents (CAPI) licence number (if applicable).
A copy of your current National Police Check Certificate (PDF, JPG, or PNG format).
A current credit card for payment.

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to apply for a commercial agent licence.

more_info.text: From 1 July 2022, regulation of the commercial agent industry moved from the NSW Police Force to NSW Fair Trading. Visit the NSW Fair Trading website for details of Commercial agent licensing and field agent rules in NSW.

Commercial agents who held a current CAPI licence on 30 June 2022, may be eligible for a refund for the remaining period of their licence. The Security Licensing & Enforcement Directorate (SLED), NSW Police Force, will contact CAPI licensees.
Private inquiry agents (now known as private investigators) will continue to be regulated by the NSW Police Force, under the Security Industry Act 1997.

faqs.q: Do I need a licence if I am a commercial agent?
faqs.a: Yes, if you are a commercial agent who has face-to-face contact with customers (a field agent), you must hold a licence to collect debts, repossess goods, and serve legal documents on behalf of a client.

faqs.q: What happens if I already have a CAPI licence?
faqs.a: Field agents who already hold a Commercial Agents and Private Inquiry Agents (CAPI) licence will need a new commercial agent licence before the CAPI expiry date or 1 July 2023, whichever is sooner.

faqs.q: How do I apply for the licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a 1, 3, or 5-year licence by checking your eligibility, gathering supporting documents, and following the prompts to apply online.
